title: Broker profile
description: The ONLY place broker-specific knowledge exists (spec FR-017). Adding a broker is a new file validating against this schema and zero code changes (FR-018). One contract covers both flat transaction lists and sectioned statements (FR-019) via the `reader` discriminator — see research.md R-003.

name.description: Broker identity stamped onto every lot and disposal this profile creates (FR-023).

reader.description: How to get from a file to a stream of field-mapped rows. Everything downstream is shared.

split_marker.description: Separator for composite values such as 'MM/DD/YYYY as of MM/DD/YYYY'.

prefer_as_of.description: When split, take the effective date. Holding period runs from it, so this changes tax outcomes.

actions.description: Routing rules, FIRST MATCH WINS. A row matching none is reported as unrecognised and never silently dropped (FR-022).

tabularReader.description: One flat table, possibly preceded by title lines (Schwab shape).

header_tokens.description: The header row is the first line containing ALL of these.

columns.description: Canonical field -> candidate column names in priority order. Unlisted canonical fields are absent for this broker.

sectionedReader.description: Many sections, each with its own header (IBKR activity-statement shape).

row_type_column.description: Zero-based index of the Header/Data/Total discriminator column.

name.description: Label attached to each row as `section`, matchable by an action rule.

section_name.description: Value in the file's first column.

field_map.description: Canonical field -> the single column name in this section.

actionRule.description: All present predicates must hold (ANDed). At least one predicate is required, except for the catch-all whose `match` is '.*'.

match.description: Regex against the row's action field.

section.description: Match rows from this reader section — how a sectioned broker routes without an action column.

qty_sign.description: REQUIRED for brokers that encode buy/sell in the sign of quantity rather than in an action string (IBKR). Without it every trade routes to one event — see research.md R-003.

funding.description: Funding key for lots this rule creates. Required when event creates a lot.

lapse.description: Match this disposal to the vest lot it came from by specific identification rather than FIFO.

bucket.description: For event: ignore — why it was ignored, so it is accounted for rather than dropped (SC-007).
